Obtain a Customs Import Permit
Learn how to obtain a Customs Import Permit by registering for a Unique Entity Number, activating your Customs account, and applying through TradeNet.
To import goods into Singapore, you must submit a Customs Import Permit through TradeNet.
Before You Apply
1. Register for a Unique Entity Number
blocks.section: 1. Register for a Unique Entity Number

blocks.text: You must first register with the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) ↗ (opens in new tab) or the relevant Unique Entity Number (UEN) issuance agency ↗ (opens in new tab) to obtain a UEN.
blocks.section: 1. Register for a Unique Entity Number

blocks.text: 2. Activate Your Customs Account
After receiving your UEN, activate your Customs Account with Singapore Customs. This is required before any import permit application can be submitted.
How You Can Apply for Import Permits
blocks.section: How You Can Apply for Import Permits

blocks.text: Once your Customs Account is activated, you may choose one of the following options:
blocks.section: How You Can Apply for Import Permits

blocks.text: Option A: Appoint a Declaring Agent
blocks.section: Option A: Appoint a Declaring Agent

blocks.text: A Declaring Agent (DA) can apply for customs permits on your behalf.
blocks.section: Option A: Appoint a Declaring Agent

blocks.text: Option B: Apply for Permits Yourself
blocks.section: Option B: Apply for Permits Yourself

blocks.text: If you prefer to make declarations yourself or for your clients, you must:
blocks.section: Option B: Apply for Permits Yourself

blocks.text: Register as a DA, and
blocks.section: Option B: Apply for Permits Yourself

blocks.text: Apply for a TradeNet User ID ↗ (opens in new tab) to access the system.
blocks.section: Option B: Apply for Permits Yourself

blocks.text: How to Submit Permit Applications
All import permit applications must be submitted through TradeNet, using one of the following channels:
TradeNet front-end software from an approved software vendor ; or
Government Front-End Application ↗ (opens in new tab)
These channels allow you or your DA to process import declarations and receive approved permit notifications.
After You Apply
Once your permit is approved, follow the conditions stated on the permit for cargo clearance and payment of duties and GST (where applicable).
Ready to apply?
Submit your application through TradeNet using your preferred front-end channel.
